tree_evidence: P3-2 (docs/phase-3/data-parity.md): data-parity compared every passive and mastery effect of this bundle with PoB v2.67.2's TreeData/3_29/tree.lua (latestTreeVersion, tools/oracle/data/pob_data.lua); every difference is categorized (none uncategorized), and none is a node or mastery the tree file lacks. 3_29_ruthless is the Ruthless tree, another game mode. PoB computes a build of another tree version with that version's tree file (Classes/PassiveSpec.lua Init: main:LoadTree(treeVersion); it converts only when the user asks), which the bundle does not hold.

excluded_mechanics.reason: A timeless jewel changes the nodes in its radius by seed and conqueror, from the timeless jewel tables (LegionPassives and the per-jewel lookup files), which the bundle does not carry; PoB reads its own copies of them (Data/TimelessJewelData).

A cluster jewel adds passive nodes that are not in the tree (PassiveTreeExpansionJewels, PassiveTreeExpansionSkills, PassiveTreeExpansionSpecialSkills), which the bundle does not carry; PoB numbers them from 65536 up, so the survey also sees them as unknown passives.
P3-2's not-carried rules: passives that grant a buff or a skill (PassiveSkillBuffs, GrantedEffectsPerLevel) and bloodline passives (DescendancyKey), whose effect or link the bundle does not carry.
